turns.q: I placed an order a few days ago and still have no tracking, where is it?
turns.replyTail:
Support
Order processing and tracking setup usually takes about 48 to 72 hours from the time your order is placed.
Once your order ships, a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking link is sent out. After you receive that email, please allow up to 24 to 48 hours for the tracking details to update with the carrier.
If it has been more than 6 business days without any tracking updates, please let us know so our team can look into it for you. Is there anything else I can help you with?

How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Support
Orders are processed within 24 to 72 hours of placement. Once your order ships, a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking link is sent out.
For US orders, please allow 24 to 48 hours after receiving the confirmation email for the tracking details to update with the carrier. For international orders, tracking updates can take up to 48 hours.
Is there anything else I can help you with?

Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Support
Once shipped, domestic Standard Shipping typically takes 10 to 14 business days (excluding weekends and holidays). If you selected Priority Shipping, delivery usually takes 7 to 10 business days.
For international orders, delivery generally takes 7 to 10 business days, though it can take up to 25 or more business days depending on the destination country.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
